visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen layout features two individuals at the top—a male in a black shirt and a female in a white t-shirt—focused intently on their smartphones. Below them, a high-action MOBA game screen is shown, featuring vibrant character avatars moving through a detailed fantasy environment with health bars and status icons visible. (2) The visual transitions into a fast-paced gameplay montage dominated by magical skill effects in neon yellow and blue. The players in the upper window react with dynamic facial expressions, including focused gazes and squinting, while their hands move rapidly across their mobile screens to control the game characters. (3) The segment concludes with the two players engaging in a lively discussion; the female player smiles and laughs while the male player appears relieved, wiping his forehead. Large, colorful text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear periodically in the center of the frame to highlight key moments of the game and their reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop BGM characterized by a steady four-on-the-floor beat. A female voice enters with high energy and a playful, rising intonation. Digital SFX from the game interface, including selection chimes and ambient battle noises, layer under the speech. (2) As the gameplay intensifies, the audio mix becomes dense with rapid percussive 'impact' and 'whoosh' sound effects signaling skill deployments. The female speaker's arousal increases significantly, leading to loud, high-pitched exclamations. Fast-paced verbal commentary is punctuated by cartoonish comedy SFX and short bursts of digital UI blips. (3) The BGM maintains its rhythm as the vocal tone shifts toward a satisfied and humorous mood. Frequent laughing from both speakers is clearly heard. A synthesized applause track and a 'ding' sound effect emphasize the successful conclusion of the match, followed by a series of casual, conversational vocal exchanges with a high Signal-to-Noise Ratio.
